description: This file defines the IStreamSubscriptionManager interface, which manages stream subscriptions within the Orleans.Streams.Core namespace. It contains method signatures for adding, removing, and retrieving stream subscriptions, indicating its role in stream subscription management.

classes.name: IStreamSubscriptionManager
classes.description: Interface for managing stream subscriptions, including adding, removing, and querying subscriptions.

methods.name: AddSubscription
methods.description: Subscribes a grain to a stream, returning a Task containing the StreamSubscription.

methods.name: RemoveSubscription
methods.description: Unsubscribes a grain from a stream, returning a Task representing the operation.

methods.name: GetSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a given stream.
